page.overview:
Who is Apu Nahasapeemapetilon Sr.?

Apu Nahasapeemapetilon Sr. was the father of Apu, Jr., Sanjay and Tikku Nahasapeemapetilon. He's also the husband of Mrs. Nahasapeemapetilon and the paternal grandfather of The Octuplets, Pahusacheta and Jamshed Nahasapeemapetilon.

He was seen in a flashback, saying goodbye to Apu when he leaves for America. He is later seen again in another flashback, where he and his wife negotiate with Manjula's family over the arranged marriage of their two children.

He may have been a Stonecutter since his son was a Stonecutter.
